name: TRAPPIST-1c
tagline: Germà de massa venusiana orbitant en la calor interna de la cadena ressonant.
history: TRAPPIST-1c is about Venus's mass and receives about Venus's share of starlight — an almost uncanny echo. Whether it shares Venus's fate — a dense, choking greenhouse — is an open JWST question; early observations suggest little or no thick CO₂ atmosphere remains after billions of years beside a flaring dwarf. It orbits in a precise 8:5 resonance with b: every eight years of c match five of its inner neighbor, part of the seven-planet harmony that makes this system the Solar System's most studied rival.
